What I tutor

Four focused offers — not everything for everyone. Each starts with a diagnostic so we spend time only on what will actually move the score, the essay, or the grade.

1 — SAT & ACT Prep

For sophomores and juniors who want a strategy, not just more practice tests. We diagnose by section, fix the highest-value gaps first, and build test-day timing.

  • Full diagnostic + section-by-section score plan
  • Digital SAT reading, writing & math strategies
  • ACT English, math, reading & science pacing
  • Timed practice with reviewed mistakes — every session
  • Custom homework between sessions (30–45 min/day)

2 — College Essay Writing & Editing

For seniors (and juniors starting early) who have a story but need help making it sound like them — only sharper. I coach and edit; I never write the essay for the student.

  • Brainstorming: find the story only you can tell
  • Structure & outline for the personal statement
  • Line-by-line editing for clarity, voice & word count
  • Supplementals: Why Us, Why Major, activity essays
  • Two revision rounds included per essay

3 — High School Math

For students who are falling behind, stuck at a B, or pushing for an A in an AP class. We work from your school's actual homework and tests, so sessions translate directly to grades.

  • Algebra I & II, Geometry, Pre-Calculus
  • AP Calculus AB, AP Statistics
  • Homework help + test prep before every exam
  • Re-teaching the concept, not just the answer
  • Optional weekly grade check-in

4 — Economics

For high school students in AP Micro, AP Macro, or intro economics — and anyone who wants the graphs to finally make sense. As a Wharton student, I use these models every day, so we learn them the way they're actually applied, not just memorized.

  • AP Microeconomics & AP Macroeconomics
  • Supply & demand, elasticity, and market structures
  • GDP, inflation, fiscal & monetary policy
  • Graphing fluency + FRQ practice and feedback
  • Homework help + test prep before every exam

How it works — without the back-and-forth

Booking, reminders, homework, and updates run on a simple system. You book once; the rest happens automatically.

1

Free intro call

20 minutes on Zoom with parent + student. We talk goals, timeline, and fit — no pressure to book.

2

Diagnostic & plan

A short diagnostic (test, essay draft, or recent math test) becomes a written plan with targets and dates.

3

Weekly sessions

Same time each week, online on Zoom. Automated reminders the day before. Homework assigned in-session.

4

Parent update

A short weekly note: what we covered, what's next, and whether homework got done. No surprises at report-card time.

My tutoring principles

• Diagnose first. No generic worksheets.
• Student does the writing. Especially for essays — I coach and edit, the voice stays theirs.
• Parents stay in the loop. A short update every week.
• Small roster. When I'm full, I run a waitlist rather than diluting sessions.

Questions parents ask first

Are you really only a freshman? Why not hire a big company?

Yes — Wharton freshman at UPenn. The advantage is recency: I took the digital SAT format and wrote application essays in the current admissions cycle, while offering true 1-on-1 attention. If you want a large test-prep company with a call center, I'm not that — and I'll say so on our intro call if that's a better fit.

Do you offer a score guarantee?

No — and be wary of anyone who does without fine print. What I guarantee is a diagnostic, a written plan, tracked practice scores, and honest updates. If practice scores aren't moving after four sessions, we change the plan or you can stop anytime.

Will you write my child's college essay?

No. I brainstorm, outline, and edit with the student. The ideas and the writing are theirs — that's both the ethical line and what admissions readers can actually tell.

How does scheduling work?

We pick a recurring weekly time on the intro call. You get a calendar invite and automatic reminders. Reschedule free with 24 hours' notice.

How many students do you take?

A small roster each term so I can prep properly for every session. If I'm full, the form below puts you on the waitlist and I'll reach out when a slot opens.
